verdict: Paid channels are off; GBP is the only active channel and stalling.
narrative: This period, no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads, which means paid lead generation produced zero leads and zero cost per lead to report. Your Google Business Profile (GBP) listing received 100 impressions and drove 85 direction requests over 28 days, but converted zero phone calls — and GBP activity dropped 70% in the most recent week, so even that organic signal is weakening. Website sessions also trended down, falling from a peak of 56 daily sessions in late September to an average of roughly 20 in the last few days, with no paid traffic to support the floor. A set of pre-launch build items — including landing pages, ad tracking infrastructure, and CRM configuration — are being resolved this week to clear the path to campaign activation. Once those are confirmed complete, paid campaigns are ready to go live and you should see lead volume begin moving in the next reporting period.
